quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Hat!
quests.question: h
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with a curved leg beside it.
quests.explanation: Yes! THat's the lowercase letter h — just like Hat! 🎩
quests.funFact: The tallest hat in the world was over 15 feet tall!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Ice Cream!
quests.question: i
quests.hint: Look for a short straight line with a small dot on top.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter i — just like Ice Cream! 🍦
quests.funFact: It takes about 50 licks to finish a single scoop of ice cream!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Juice!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: It has a curved hook with a small dot on top. That's the letter that starts Juice! 🧃
quests.explanation: Great job! j is for Juice. 🧃
quests.funFact: It takes about 3 to 4 medium oranges to make one glass of fresh orange juice!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Kite!
quests.question: K
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with two legs kicking out to the side.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter K — just like Kite! 🪁
quests.funFact: Kites were invented in China over 2,000 years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Lion!
quests.question: L
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with a short line along the bottom, like a foot.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter L — just like Lion! 🦁
quests.funFact: A lion's roar is so loud it can be heard from 5 miles away!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Monkey!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: It has two tall lines with a peak dipping down between them, like mountains. That's the letter that starts Monkey! 🐒
quests.explanation: Great job! M is for Monkey. 🐒
quests.funFact: Spider monkeys have strong tails that they use like an extra arm!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Ninja!
quests.question: n
quests.hint: Look for one little hump, like a small hill.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter n — just like Ninja! 🥷
quests.funFact: Ninjas wore dark blue clothes at night, not black, to blend in better with the sky!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Owl!
quests.question: o
quests.hint: Look for a round circle, like a little wheel.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter o — just like Owl! 🦉
quests.funFact: Owls can't move their eyeballs, so they have to turn their entire heads to look around!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Penguin!
quests.question: p
quests.hint: It has a tall line that dips below, with a round bump on top. That's the letter that starts Penguin! 🐧
quests.explanation: Great job! p is for Penguin. 🐧
quests.funFact: Penguins don't have teeth; they have fleshy spines inside their mouths to swallow fish!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Quilt!
quests.question: Q
quests.hint: Look for a big circle with a small tail crossing the bottom.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter Q — just like Quilt! 🛌
quests.funFact: The oldest known quilt is over 2,000 years old!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Robot!
quests.question: R
quests.hint: Look for a tall line with a round bump on top and a leg kicking out.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter R — just like Robot! 🤖
quests.funFact: The word 'robot' comes from a Czech word meaning forced labor!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Shark!
quests.question: S
quests.hint: It has a curvy line that curls one way then the other. That's the letter that starts Shark! 🦈
quests.explanation: Great job! S is for Shark. 🦈
quests.funFact: Sharks have been on Earth longer than trees have!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Tiger!
quests.question: t
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with a small crossbar near the top.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter t — just like Tiger! 🐅
quests.funFact: A tiger's stripes are like fingerprints; no two tigers have the exact same pattern!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Unicorn!
quests.question: u
quests.hint: Look for a curved dip with a short straight line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter u — just like Unicorn! 🦄
quests.funFact: The unicorn is the national animal of Scotland!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Volcano!
quests.question: v
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in a point at the bottom, like a checkmark. That's the letter that starts Volcano! 🌋
quests.explanation: Great job! v is for Volcano. 🌋
quests.funFact: There are volcanoes on other planets, and the biggest one is on Mars!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Whale!
quests.question: W
quests.hint: Look for four slanted lines dipping up and down, like two V's together.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter W — just like Whale! 🐋
quests.funFact: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word X-ray!
quests.question: X
quests.hint: Look for two slanted lines crossing in the middle.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter X — just like X-ray! 🩻
quests.funFact: X-rays were discovered completely by accident in 1895!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Yak!
quests.question: Y
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in the middle, sitting on one straight line. That's the letter that starts Yak! 🐂
quests.explanation: Great job! Y is for Yak. 🐂
quests.funFact: Yaks have larger lungs and hearts than most cattle to help them live in high mountains!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Zoo!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: Look for a zigzag line -- straight, slanted, then straight again.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter z — just like Zoo! 🦁
quests.funFact: The oldest zoo in the world still operating today is in Vienna, built in 1752!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Astronaut!
quests.question: a
quests.hint: Look for a small circle with a short line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter a — just like Astronaut! 🧑‍🚀
quests.funFact: Astronauts can grow up to two inches taller while living in space!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Ball!
quests.question: b
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with one round bump at the bottom. That's the letter that starts Ball! ⚽
quests.explanation: Great job! b is for Ball. 🏀
quests.funFact: The first rubber balls were made in ancient Mexico thousands of years ago!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Cat!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: Look for a big curved line, open on the right, like a large moon.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter C — just like Cat! 🐱
quests.funFact: Cats have a special collarbone that helps them almost always land on their feet!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Dolphin!
quests.question: D
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with one big round curve on the right.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter D — just like Dolphin! 🐬
quests.funFact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open to watch out for danger!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Eagle!
quests.question: E
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with three short lines like little shelves. That's the letter that starts Eagle! 🦅
quests.explanation: Great job! E is for Eagle. 🦅
quests.funFact: An eagle's eyes are so powerful they can spot a rabbit from two miles away!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Frog!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: It has a tall line with a small crossbar, like a tiny flagpole. That's the letter that starts Frog! 🐸
quests.explanation: Great job! f is for Frog. 🐸
quests.funFact: Frogs drink water by absorbing it directly through their skin!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Guitar!
quests.question: g
quests.hint: Look for a small circle with a curved tail that hangs below the line.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the lowercase letter g — just like Guitar! 🎸
quests.funFact: The world's smallest guitar is no bigger than a single human blood cell!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Horse!
quests.question: h
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a curved leg beside it. THorse's the letter tHorse starts Horse! 🐴
quests.explanation: Great job! h is for Horse. 🐴
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing up and lying down!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Igloo!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone. That's the letter that starts Igloo! 🧊
quests.explanation: Great job! I is for Igloo. 🧊
quests.funFact: An igloo can be 40 degrees warmer inside than outside, just from body heat!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Jellyfish!
quests.question: J
quests.hint: Look for a tall line that curves into a hook at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Yes! That's the uppercase letter J — just like Jellyfish! 🪼
quests.funFact: Jellyfish don't have brains, hearts, or bones, and are 95% water!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Kangaroo!
quests.question: K
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with two legs kicking out to the side. That's the letter that starts Kangaroo! 🦘
quests.explanation: Great job! K is for Kangaroo. 🦘
quests.funFact: Kangaroos use their strong tails for balance, so if you lift their tail, they can't hop!
